svg.title: Glide: design visually, ship real source code
svg.desc: Glide wordmark beside the tagline "Design visually. Ship real source code.", with the words "real source code" selected the way the Glide editor selects an element.

g.text: A VISUAL EDITOR FOR YOUR CODEBASE
Select, restyle and drag elements on your running app.
Glide writes each change into the file it came from.
